channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: The U.S. Military Wants A.I. Dominance. Feuds and China May Thwart It.
item.description: The administration is veering wildly in its response to the national security implications of A.I. as China, America’s main technological and military rival, charges ahead.

item.title: WIRED Science: Inside the Experimental Traps Scientists Set for Ghostly Neutrinos
item.description: Observatories have been built in mines, deep under the Antarctic ice sheet, and elsewhere in an effort to detect the fleeting particles.

item.title: WIRED Business: The Next Big Influencer Is This 4-Foot-Tall Robot From China

item.title: The New Yorker: Donald Trump Is Still Trying to Make It Harder to Vote

item.description: The fixation on the redemptive power of being chosen might be outdated.
